sessionConductor.help.undo.title: Undo last message (plugin feature)
sessionConductor.help.undo.desc: Removes the last user message (and its reply turn) from the session record, like a message recall. It edits session.jsonl.zstd directly, with preview + confirmation before applying, and backs up the original file to .undo-backup/.
sessionConductor.repair.scanClean: Scan done: no corrupt session logs found
sessionConductor.repair.confirm: Found {n} corrupt session log(s) (tool-result content format). Repair rewrites the log files (keeps a .bak-corrupt backup). Proceed?
sessionConductor.repair.done: Repair done: {n} session(s) fixed (originals backed up as .bak-corrupt)
sessionConductor.help.repair.desc: Session logs can be corrupted by an old tool output format (history unavailable). This scans all cold sessions, detects problems with DSH's own validation rules, and auto-repairs. Safe to re-run.
sessionConductor.repairEio.scanClean: EIO scan done: no unreadable session logs found
sessionConductor.repairEio.confirm: Found {n} session log(s) with EIO bad blocks (underlying storage I/O error). Repair truncates to the last intact data boundary on a new block (keeps a .eio-backup backup). Proceed?
sessionConductor.repairEio.done: EIO repair done: {n} session(s) fixed (originals backed up)
sessionConductor.help.repairEio.desc: Underlying storage corruption (e.g. BTRFS csum failure / iSCSI LUN I/O error) makes some 4KB blocks of a session log throw EIO on read; the gateway reports "EIO: i/o error, read". This scans block-level health, truncates to intact data (COW new block), and lets DSH auto-finish the torn tail. Safe to re-run.
sessionConductor.repairDual.scanClean: Dual-format scan done: no session dir holding both session.jsonl and session.jsonl.zstd
sessionConductor.repairDual.confirm: Found {n} dual-format session(s) (same dir holds both plain session.jsonl and compressed session.jsonl.zstd, which makes the whole session list fail and sessions vanish from the sidebar). Repair moves the extra plaintext into .dual-format-backup/ keeping the zstd official format. Proceed?
sessionConductor.repairDual.done: Dual-format repair done: {n} session(s) fixed (extra plaintext backed up to .dual-format-backup)
sessionConductor.help.repairDual.desc: When a session dir holds both session.jsonl (plain) and session.jsonl.zstd (compressed), DSH's official listArtifacts() throws encodingMismatch and the entire session list fails (sessions vanish from the sidebar). This scans at disk level (bypassing persistence) and moves the extra plaintext into .dual-format-backup/ keeping the zstd official format. Safe to re-run.
sessionConductor.confirm.releaseAll.title: Release all idle sessions?
sessionConductor.confirm.releaseAll.body: Running sessions are skipped. Released sessions stay visible in the sidebar and re-attach automatically when opened or messaged.
sessionConductor.confirm.delete.title: Permanently delete session "{title}"?
sessionConductor.confirm.delete.body: This cannot be undone (the session log will be removed too).
sessionConductor.help.delete.title: Delete session (added by this plugin)
sessionConductor.help.delete.desc: The built-in UI has no way to delete a session. This plugin adds it: refuses to delete a running session, double-checks before deleting, removes the log for good.
sessionConductor.help.autoRename.title: Auto-rename (added by this plugin)
sessionConductor.help.autoRename.desc: Turn on "Auto-rename" for a session and after each finished turn the plugin asks an AI to compare recent session content against the current title; when the topic has clearly drifted it generates a new title and renames automatically. Titles carry a live state suffix: "（运行中）" = turn in progress, "（已中断）" = crashed/errored and waiting to resume; updated at turn boundaries. Rate-limited (5 min interval, needs a few new messages) to keep token costs low.
sessionConductor.help.autoContinue.title: Auto-resume (added by this plugin)
sessionConductor.help.autoContinue.desc: With "Auto-resume" checked, the plugin reads session records: when the last turn ended in a non-human interruption (process crash, a failed turn — any request error like rate limit/timeout/server/auth/context-length, or a system abort) it automatically asks the AI to continue the original task. ⚠️ Auto-resume is OFF by default (v1.35.3): enable it per session from the "⋯" menu; once enabled, a detected failed turn (error) waits 30 seconds before auto-resume, to avoid immediate retry. ⚠️ This switch is TEMPORARY (v1.35.9): it lives only in the running process memory and resets to the default (off) when DSH restarts — it is never written to disk; use the defaultAutoContinue config for a lasting default. Manual stops and goal pauses are NOT auto-resumed. Guardrails: 15 min cooldown per session, max 3 auto-resumes per session, max 2 concurrent resumes, and auto-resume pauses when the number of attached sessions reaches the cap (default 12) — no infinite loops, no resource buildup. You can always hit "Resume" manually to continue any interrupted session.
sessionConductor.help.release.title: Set inactive (added by this plugin)
sessionConductor.help.release.desc: In DSH a session stays in memory once opened (the attached count only grows). "Set inactive" / "Release all idle" detaches the agent of an idle session back to cold persisted state: the transcript is fully kept, the session stays listed, and reopening or messaging re-attaches it automatically. Running sessions are never released.
sessionConductor.help.tip: This plugin adds: view archived, restore, delete, auto-rename, auto-resume, and set-inactive.
sessionConductor.help.grouped.title: All sessions grouped by workspace (v0.6.0)
sessionConductor.help.grouped.desc: The "All sessions" view is sectioned by the deepest ancestor group of each session cwd: group headers show counts and collapse, 0-session groups are hidden, unmatched go to "Ungrouped".
sessionConductor.help.newSession.title: New session defaults to workspace (v0.9.0)
sessionConductor.help.newSession.desc: New sessions are no longer blocked: without a workspaceId they land in the workspace folder one level above .dsh (created automatically if missing).
sessionConductor.help.value.title: Session value analysis (v1.11.0)
sessionConductor.help.value.desc: Classify sessions by value: completed (final reply has ✅ done + ═ separator), unfinished (⚠️/❌ marks or interruption), stale (>3 days idle), active — each with a final-reply summary. API: POST /api/session-conductor/value-analysis.

sessionGroup.title: Session Groups
sessionGroup.desc: Sessions are shown grouped by workspace; "New session in group" creates one (no workspaceId = last session's workspace). Group creation/management uses DSH's native workspace mechanism.

sessionConductorCompaction.title: Compaction Model
sessionConductorCompaction.desc: Model used for automatic context compaction: choose a cheap model (e.g. agnes) to save pro cost; default follows the session model.
sessionConductorCompaction.followNote: Compaction uses the same model as the session (pro sessions pay pro for compaction too)

sessionConductorSettings.title: Session Conductor
sessionConductorSettings.desc: Central settings: extra injected md (local file or online URL, persistent in session context).
sessionConductorSettings.noteBody: Session grouping / migration / compaction model stay under Settings → Plugins → Plugin config cards; the sidebar-bottom "Session Conductor" button is the session operations panel.
sessionConductorSettings.scopeHint: Changes save immediately; injection applies from the next turn (no restart).
sessionConductorSettings.tpl.emptyHint: (No content yet. Imported content shows below and stays editable)
sessionConductorSettings.tpl.title: Template injection (plan / closing)
sessionConductorSettings.tpl.desc: Two fixed template slots: plan template (draft a proposal before changing code) and closing template (task completion report format). One unified entry for the three import methods: pick a method from the dropdown, click Import, then the matching picker opens (local file = pick from device / online URL = URL input / DSH dir = directory browser) and stores the content; imported content shows in the editable box below (auto-height, wraps) and can be re-edited and saved. When enabled, content is injected into the system prompt so the AI sees it from the start. ≤256KB each.
sessionConductorSettings.tpl.planDesc: Draft a plan proposal per this template before changing code (goal/files/impact/risk/steps/verify).
sessionConductorSettings.tpl.closingDesc: Task completion report format (divider + done marker + delivered/verified/remaining).
sessionConductorSettings.tpl.dirHint: Click a directory to enter; click a .md file to select it, then click Import to store (read-only DSH home tree).
sessionConductorSettings.armDesc: Model used by auto-rename (AI refines the session title after each real user message). Follows the session model by default; pick a cheaper/dedicated model, saved immediately, takes effect on next analysis.
